known_gaps: Assists exist for 277 of 391 goals; the rest have no assist in the source (penalties, solo goals).
Red and second-yellow cards now come from FotMob through the shirt-number bridge; the official page itself still publishes none.
Team names, player names and all other fields remain the official Japanese ones.
37 fixtures are scheduled but not yet played.

fotmob_enrichment.method: FotMob player id -> shirt number -> official J.League roster number -> Japanese name
fotmob_enrichment.note: Adds the four fields the official site does not publish while keeping the Japanese naming: formations, red cards and second yellows, assists, and a shot table with xG. No romaji name was written and no row was guessed.
